activeRecovery.reason: Only enabled queue entry remains buyer-unverified more than 6 hours after creation, and generation 1 produced no verified ledger entry after more than 30 minutes.
rules: Do not trust local success state unless publication_ledger has matching publicUrlVerified=true.
Reconstruct all listed chunks in order and require SHA-256 to equal ce4ebfb5b07a9e05b8e1d79a920b09e1cb010f0521ee24130ff92270d284f79f before decrypting.
Generation 2 is escalated: reconcile an exact-title existing draft only if it can immediately become buyer-visible; otherwise perform a clean rebuild from the decrypted canonical package.
Do not stop at management-page success, publish-click success, or a derived URL.
After publish, verify anonymously that the exact title is visible, the page is buyer-accessible, the item is a downloadable product, the expected price is shown, and a purchase path is present.
Only after verification append the real BOOTH item ID and URL to publication_ledger.json with publicUrlVerified=true.
If verification fails, preserve the encrypted source package, leave recovery active, increment diagnostic failure state locally, and retry rather than marking success.
